metadata.dcterms:abstract: This web annex provides the standardized indicators and performance metrics supporting the WHO Digital adaptation kit for HIV: operational requirements for implementing WHO recommendations in digital systems. It defines a comprehensive set of indicators for monitoring HIV prevention, testing, treatment, care, diagnostics and programme performance, translating WHO recommendations into standardized indicator specifications that can be incorporated into digital health systems. For each indicator, the annex documents indicator definitions, calculation methods, numerators and denominators, disaggregation variables, required data elements, reporting requirements, data sources, implementation notes and mappings to international monitoring frameworks, including WHO, UNAIDS, Global Fund and PEPFAR indicators where applicable. Intended for programme managers, monitoring and evaluation specialists, digital health architects and software developers, this resource supports the standardized measurement, reporting and analysis of HIV programme performance while promoting interoperability, consistent implementation of WHO recommendations and adaptation to national monitoring requirements.
